prompt:

A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: mid-twenties — a clear adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: a boyish, mischievous tomboy energy; light warm-beige skin with a golden undertone; heart-shaped face; medium-sized eyes — narrow upturned eyes, outer eye corners slightly lifted; thick straight brows; upturned nose; a wide mouth with softly upturned corners; flint-grey eyes flecked with bright spark-gold; a dusting of freckles across nose and cheeks.
Body and hair: athletic build; short cropped hair with center-parted bangs framing the face; ripe wheat-gold hair scattered with tiny bright spark-white glints like struck flint.
Expression: a small closed-lip smile that reaches the eyes.
Her element, carried in her design: cerium: a soft, silvery-grey rare-earth metal, the most abundant of the rare earths, named in 1803 for the newly found small world Ceres, goddess of grain and harvest; its shavings catch fire in air when scratched, and alloyed with iron into ferrocerium it becomes the flint of lighters and fire-starters, throwing showers of hot yellow-white sparks when struck; pale cerium oxide powder polishes glass and lenses crystal clear.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — MECHA
Costume: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. Flint-grey and wheat-gold armor with a slender torso and oversized mechanical striker gauntlets and boots, steel striker ridges along the outer forearms that throw bright yellow-white spark showers whenever they meet, pale ceria-cream inner plates, a small spark-gold core at the chest; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown.
Silhouette: a slender torso with oversized mechanical forearms and lower legs — huge gauntlets and boots — the contrast is the main shape. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette.
Colours: ripe wheat gold, flint grey, hot spark yellow-white, pale ceria cream.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare shoulders and upper arms between pauldron and gauntlet, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2200, a grain colony on the dwarf planet Ceres: rows of glowing grain domes beside the dazzling white salt spots of a great crater floor, a polishing hall where cerium-oxide slurry buffs giant telescope lenses crystal clear, a small far sun in a black sky.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Ce) and atomic number (58) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish.
